elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: The clause provides that any defaulting Party, which includes Customer if in default, is not liable for any liquidated damages or penalty in respect of reclaimed capacity, and that amounts already paid shall not be forfeited. No other Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties appear in the rendered language.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: No Customer-payable liquidated amount exists in the rendered language, so the condition underlying this element is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no early-termination fee or three-month cap.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: The rendered language prohibits the relevant liquidated damages rather than designating an early-termination fee as the sole liquidated amount.
